item.text:
The DAG is not complete. The largest gaps are the unramified-base extension, the measure/count passage, several circular semantic-interface dependencies, and an attack order that places an upstream realization obligation last.

## Missing nodes

1. **BLOCKER — Haar/counting limit bridge is not a node.**  
   The assembly uses all of the following together: splitting-type loci are Borel measurable; level-\(N\) classes are measurable cylinders of mass \(p^{-nN}\); decided cylinders are nested; their union agrees almost everywhere with the semantic splitting-type locus; and continuity from below converts finite counts into Haar density. T-6’s null-locus result and O-4’s “cylinder mass identity” are fragments, but no node states this complete bridge with the needed quantifiers.

2. **BLOCKER — semantic partition and rational identity step are missing.**  
   To obtain \(\sum_\sigma R_\sigma=1\) identically, the proof needs:

   - every separable monic polynomial to have exactly one degree-\(n\) splitting type;
   - the nonseparable locus to have measure zero;
   - hence \(\sum_\sigma R_\sigma(p)=1\) at infinitely many regular primes;
   - therefore the equality holds in \(\mathbb Q(t)\).

   Pieces occur in K-11, T-6, O-5, and K-13, but the assembled implication is not a node.

3. **BLOCKER — the unramified-base claim lacks a semantic transfer package.**  
   The root covers every unramified extension of \(\mathbb Q_p\), but O-1–O-7 and the canonical classifier are stated over \(\mathbb Z_p/\mathbb Q_p\). LIT-4 even says its audited scope is “at \(K=\mathbb Q_p\) exactly.” O-8b only rebases the carry-algebra alphabet, and O-9 only asserts a census formula. Neither supplies the unramified versions of K-DICT, K-RUN, K-HALT/ASSEMBLY, drainage, Haar normalization, and sibling independence.

4. **BLOCKER — recursion base cases are absent.**  
   The branch/convolution recursion descends to degree \(1\), and potentially uses degree \(0\) empty products. No node states the degree-\(1\) density, the terminal classifier behavior, or the empty-child conventions needed by the finite solve. Mentioning an \(n=1\) catalogue in O-13 is not this base case.

5. **BLOCKER — canonical-object well-posedness is not a node.**  
   The leaves repeatedly quantify over \(T_{\rm can}(f)\), “realized sites,” “ns-free carriers,” resolution levels, fresh frames, letters, skeletons, and certification predicates. The document supplies no mathematical node proving that these objects are defined, canonical, invariant under presentation choices, and compatible across truncation levels. O-2 proves a hoped-for correspondence, not basic well-definedness of the engine objects themselves.

6. **BLOCKER — pole-free specialization is underspecified.**  
   O-12 concerns \(N_{\Phi_e}(p^m)\) and \(\det(I-K_e)\), but the final \(R_\sigma\) also uses table coefficients, height resummations, normalizations, and other rational denominators. The root needs a claim that every denominator introduced anywhere in the solve is nonzero at every intended prime power, or an explicit proof that K-13/O-12’s “pinned rational data” includes all of them.

7. **BLOCKER — the asserted equivalence \(U\)-DENS \(\Leftrightarrow U\)-GEN is false as written.**  
   U-GEN implies the density statement. U-DENS alone does not imply finite-level brackets, drainage of this classifier, or production by a \(p\)-independent finite linear system. Assuming the bracket and drainage clauses still does not derive clause (iii), the finite-solve provenance.

## Status honesty: six spot audits

8. **BLOCKER — LIT-1’s `LITERATURE` grade is premature by the document’s own rules.**  
   Its evidence still carries a “printed-TAMS pagination confirmation” caveat, while §4 requires published-text transcription and guardian audit before a literature node is accepted. The engine-side applicability also remains conditional on O-2.

9. **BLOCKER — LIT-3 claims more readiness than its evidence supports.**  
   The citation numbers are explicitly “to confirm at declaration.” Moreover, coprime Hensel lifting alone must be paired with the irreducibility/unramified-extension conclusion in exactly the cited scope. Under the stated acceptance criterion, this is a candidate import, not yet an accepted LITERATURE node.

10. **BLOCKER — LIT-8 is an unaudited bundle, not one supported literature node.**  
    It groups Krasner, the precise \(2v+1\) constant, Newton–Hensel polishing, inverse-function/change-of-variables claims, resultant identities, and finite-field counts, while saying exact numbering remains owed. “Standard” cannot support all those precise scopes under §4’s source discipline.

11. **BLOCKER — T-1’s verified scope exceeds the evidence described.**  
    T-1 says “each OM read” is represented uniformly by the MOVES tower. The evidence described consists of symbolic carry-algebra gates and review passes. O-2 remains open precisely because the engine-to-OM correspondence is unproved. T-1 can honestly be verified as a theorem about the symbolic engine, but not with the stated semantic “each OM read” scope.

12. **BLOCKER — T-8’s claimed nonzero-pivot scope conflicts with O-12.**  
    T-8 says \(\det(I-K)\ne0\) follows from escape mass and calls the solve verified. Yet K-13/T-U restrict specialization to REG-p, and O-12 is required to prove nonvanishing at every prime. The evidence can support a formal \(\mathbb Q(q)\) solve or a REG-p-conditional specialization, not the unrestricted wording in T-8.

13. **ADVISORY — K-12 does not document the required VERIFIED-LEAN faithfulness audit.**  
    The Lean envelope theorem may be correct, but the status vocabulary requires a semantic audit that Lean’s `undec`/`hExhaustP` matches the mathematical classifier and Haar mass. The evidence description names only the Lean result.

## Dependency soundness

14. **BLOCKER — O-1/O-3 contain a circular quantifier seam.**  
    O-1’s comparison is restricted to sites already realized on the run. O-3’s no-missing direction must prove that semantic sites not yet known to be realized are produced. Such an instance-restricted locality theorem cannot establish no-missing realization. Conversely, O-1’s \(\delta\)-tier is explicitly conditional on O-3. The attack list does not isolate a noncircular theorem sufficient for O-3.

15. **BLOCKER — O-2 and O-3 are mutually dependent in substance.**  
    O-3’s no-phantom claim needs a map from engine reads to genuine OM types, which is O-2. O-2’s tree-correspondence clause speaks about “the refinement traces/trees the classifier produces,” whose semantic faithfulness is O-3. Merely ordering O-2 before O-3 does not break this cycle.

16. **BLOCKER — O-5’s listed inputs do not yield the asserted leaf/factor bijection.**  
    GMN’s product formula, defectlessness, degree checksums, and “all realized histories are chains” do not alone prove that distinct leaves correspond to distinct factors or that every factor occurs. That requires explicit disjointness, semantic coverage, and compatibility of multiplicities across all lifts. Those claims are neither O-2 nor O-3 as currently stated.

17. **BLOCKER — O-10’s theorem is stronger than its reduction.**  
    O-10 asserts exact sibling independence under level-\(N\) counting without an \(N\)-restriction. K-COUNT only promises constant fibers for \(N\ge\operatorname{thr}(c)+\sim2\rho(c)\), and the small-\(N\) case is expressly unresolved. Its dependencies therefore cannot yield the leaf as stated.

18. **BLOCKER — O-11 lacks several necessary dependencies.**  
    A per-\(\sigma\) tree-series/value tie needs correct semantic labels and transition weights, hence at least O-5 and O-9 in addition to O-10 and T-7. K3’s “[1v]-FULL value correctness” is itself routed by T-7 to O-8/O-9/O-11, creating a potential self-dependency. K-13’s finiteness of exceptional primes also does not establish K2’s semantic escape property.

19. **BLOCKER — O-12 is not a near-independent corollary of T-3/T-6.**  
    Identifying matrix entries as actual continuation-event volumes requires the table census and semantic realization seams: O-1/O-2/O-3/O-5/O-9/O-10/O-11. Strict row mass additionally needs positive termination/escape from every state, closely related to drainage. Calling O-12 an early independent win hides these gates and risks circularly using the solve’s semantics to justify the solve’s pivots.

20. **BLOCKER — O-13’s reduction does not establish its statement.**  
    A finite alphabet plus an OM order bound does not imply finitely many literal tree shapes when recentering runs can be arbitrarily long—the K-3 caterpillar refutation demonstrates exactly that. The claim may concern compressed skeletons with recentering ladders resummed, but that definition and the compression theorem are absent. As written, the proposed proof is invalid or the node is undefined.

21. **BLOCKER — O-14 is not a single settled mathematical proposition.**  
    It combines a suspected-false unguarded transport law, a proposed guarded replacement, an upstream realizer existence theorem, an “expected derivable” nonemptiness claim, and instance-building “engineering.” Consequently “all leaves proved” has no definite meaning for O-14.

## Attack-list order

22. **BLOCKER — O-14a′ must precede O-3, not come last.**  
    The document expressly says `RunRealizerExists` is an upstream stage-tower supply, and O-3 includes a nonempty-locus/witnessing-polynomial clause. O-3 cannot close before the O-14a′ residue closes or is removed from its proof.

23. **BLOCKER — O-2 cannot simply be completed before O-3 without decomposing their cycle.**  
    K-DICT’s invariant/order placement portion can be upstream, but its trace/tree-correspondence clause depends on the very realization semantics assigned to O-3.

24. **BLOCKER — O-11 is scheduled too early relative to its real prerequisites.**  
    It is listed after O-10 + T-7, but its value correctness also depends on O-5, O-8b/O-9, and the semantic mass bridge. T-7 cannot serve as an unconditional predecessor when it routes its own open value-correctness content to O-11.

25. **BLOCKER — O-12 and O-13 are not justified “early wins.”**  
    O-12 is gated on semantic mass identification and escape. O-13 is gated on defining and proving a compressed-skeleton representation that survives the unbounded-recentering counterexamples.

26. **ADVISORY — the attack list conflates alternative drainage routes.**  
    O-4 already gives qualitative drainage from local constancy plus classifier agreement. O-6/O-7/O-8a provide quantitative project-specific charging/rates. The DAG never says whether these are mandatory for the root or an alternative quantitative route through T-9. This makes the claimed critical path and the assertion that every leaf is needed inaccurate.

VERDICT: GAPS-FOUND
